results.description:
When a modern cowgirl’s career takes off like a bronco, and she’s rarely around any longer, will her old-fashioned cowboy ride into the sunset?

Ellie McLeod swore off dating cowboys after she moved away from her family ranch in the small town of King Creek, Arizona, but the chemistry between her and Tucker was unmistakable from the second he saved her at a Renaissance fair. He is everything she wants in a man and a partner. He’s strong, kind, handsome, dependable, and supportive. When her career as a voice actor takes off, she feels like the luckiest woman on earth...until their connection erodes.

Ranch owner Tucker Rawlings falls hard for Ellie. When they first met, she ran a social media company with a little voice acting on the side, and they enjoyed their time together. After voicing the main character of a new, popular video game, she’s in high demand. She’s signing autographs at conventions around the country, winning awards, and being interviewed on television. He wants a family that includes several children, and now that the opportunities are rolling in, he’s afraid the couple of years she wanted to wait will turn into never. He has a tough decision to make.

When dreams collide, can true love really conquer all?
